name: Villager Birthday Reminders
summary: A friendly letter waits in your mailbox whenever a villager has a birthday, with a gift idea they love.
logoPrompt: A wooden farm mailbox with its little red flag raised and a letter with a ribbon-tied gift box sticking out of it

cover.tagline: Never miss a villager's birthday again.

description: **Villager Birthday Reminders puts a short letter in your mailbox on the morning of each villager's birthday, so you never miss the day.**
- A letter arrives on the morning of every birthday, every year.
- Each letter suggests one gift that villager loves, picked from the game's gift data.
- Covers 33 villagers of Pelican Town and the valley, from Abigail to the Wizard.
- Letters only come for villagers you have already met, so nothing is spoiled.
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, then unzip the file into your `Mods` folder. Play as usual and check your mailbox on the next birthday.
- Needs SMAPI and Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer. Made for Stardew Valley 1.6.
- Built carefully from the documented formats of Stardew Valley 1.6 and Content Patcher. It only adds letters: no new items, no changes to villagers.
- Ginger Island villagers are not included yet.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
